# id: # Sweep S15 (scheduling boundaries and the menu), group B — the loop
# loop form a goroutine can spin in, printing one `s` per iteration after a
# wake-producing send, beside main's `m` after the wake; and three pollers
# that spin until a peer's action becomes visible through a select, a
# channel-length read or a mutex. The labelled-continue and goto forms
# travel the `contTo` path, which has no back-edge arm
# rowed; their unbounded pure spinners refuse by name under iters= (the
# re-entry is not counted) and are recorded on BUG-152's Neighbourhood line
# as coverage gaps. Lane sweep/s15-scheduling, 2026-10-27, per the
# explores the canonical slot plus one anti-progress slot at every back-edge
# consult — exhaustive at these two-goroutine menus. Each set certified by
# coverage-observations; gc go1.26.5 sampled 100 plain / 100 -race / 30 at
# GOMAXPROCS=1 under the runners' pins, every draw a member.
